description: A rectilinear grid of shallow embankments and parallel channels forming roughly 120 × 120 m blocks. On the DTM hillshade this appears as paired ridges ~20–30 m apart running E–W and intersected by N–S lines, consistent with raised‐field agriculture.

A linear ditch or causeway ~130 m long trending E–W, connecting to a short N–S segment ~50 m long. It shows a subtle concave‐plan curvature in low‐relief terrain, with a corresponding moisture anomaly in the NIR band but no match on the OSM layer.
